title: dryopteris filix-mas f. crenata
intro: Dryopteris filix-mas f. crenata, commonly known as the crested male fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. The crested male fern is a medicinal plant that has been used for centuries to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and skin problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from various diseases. The bioactive constituents of the crested male fern include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
